data.name: LetCoercionRuntimeErrorExceptionInvalidUseOfNull_Verbose
data.value: Destination data type could only be Null, Variant, or a fixed-sized array.

data.name: LetCoercionRuntimeErrorExceptionObjectRequired
data.value: The destination data type being an object or class type, the data type of the source value cannot be let-coerced, because an object is required for the source value.

data.name: LetCoercionRuntimeErrorExceptionObjectVariableNotSet
data.value: Source value 'Nothing' cannot be let-coerced to an object reference. This error usually denotes a missing 'Set' keyword, required for a reference assignment.

data.name: LetCoercionRuntimeErrorExceptionInvalidProcedureCallOrArgument_Verbose
data.value: Source value is outside the standard error code range (0 and 65535, inclusive) representable by the let-coercion destination data type.

data.name: LetCoercionRuntimeErrorExceptionObjectDoesntSupportThisPropertyOrMethod_Verbose
data.value: Source value is an object with no public default Property Get or Function callable with no arguments, so it has no simple data value that can be let-coerced to the destination declared type.

data.name: SetCoercionRuntimeErrorExceptionTypeMismatch_Verbose
data.value: The source object's class does not match, and is not implemented by, the destination's declared class.

data.name: SetCoercionRuntimeErrorExceptionObjectRequired_Verbose
data.value: The source value is not an object reference, and an object is required for Set-coercion to this destination.

data.name: LetCoercionRuntimeErrorExceptionOutOfStackSpace_Verbose
data.value: This let-coercion operation is deterministically recursive. See evaluation stack details for more information.

data.name: LetCoercionRuntimeErrorExceptionOverflow_Verbose

data.name: LetCoercionRuntimeErrorExceptionTypeMismatch_Verbose

data.value: The start, the end and the step of a For loop are numbers: this one cannot be read as a number (MS-VBAL 5.4.2.3).

data.value: {0} in a program run unattended (--unattended): nobody is there to answer it, and the run fails.

data.value: This For Each loop's collection expression is Nothing. Enumerating it requires invoking its _NewEnum member, which cannot be done on an object reference that isn't set.

data.name: VBMemberAssignment_NotAssignable_Verbose
data.value: The object has no public variable, and no Property Let or Property Set, of this name for the assignment to write to.

data.name: VBMemberAccess_ObjectVariableNotSet_Verbose

data.name: VBLSet_NoObjectAtAddress_Verbose
data.value: LSet reads an object field from bytes that are not an object's address: the number there is not what ObjPtr returned for an object that still exists, and is not 0 for Nothing. Nothing was copied.

data.name: VBLSet_ObjectOfAnotherClass_Verbose
data.value: LSet gives an object field the object of another class: a field declared as a class holds only an object of that class, or of a class that implements it, as Set would require. Nothing was copied.

data.name: VBTypeOf_ObjectVariableNotSet_Verbose
